name: incrementTableRecordField
description: Increments/decrements a field in a table record. Corresponds to PATCH /tables/{tableId}/records/{recordId}/increment. Requires `tables:write` scope. [WRITE]

fieldName.description: Numeric column to increment or decrement. Column name from getTable .columns[].name (not the label).

value.description: The amount to increment or decrement, can be positive or negative
